correctness.rationale: For canonical BV representatives, step-function signed-measure decomposition proves exact norm reduction. Binomial-tail/Beta-CDF duality and convex absolute deviation prove the finite maximum. A Beta order-statistic CLT and exact variance handle all candidate-index subsequences, including endpoints; compactness gives convergence of the maximum. Differentiating the normal absolute moment yields a derivative proportional to b²R(a)-1 where R(a)=∫_0^1 exp(a²(1-v²)/2)dv rises strictly from 1; hence only center or endpoints can globally maximize, with threshold sqrt(2/pi). Packaged check.py passed direct binomial-integral and asymptotic spot checks.

value.rationale: The square-root Stancu knot displacement is the natural critical scale matching sampling noise for discontinuous signals. A nontrivial exact threshold sqrt(2/pi) switches asymptotically worst jump placement between interior and endpoints, with a finite explicit Beta formula for all degrees and rigorously proved location rigidity; this informs parameter design and is not merely a fixed-parameter Bernstein constant re-expression.
